label: Sec. 02  The Principles
title: Themes
description: Four open themes for exploring the systems that shape how we live, connect and create.

themes.title: Ownership
themes.description: How ownership shapes value, freedom and power.

themes.title: Permanence
themes.description: The consequences of things lasting, changing or disappearing.

themes.title: Energy
themes.description: What powers the systems we depend on, and at what cost.

themes.title: Peers
themes.description: How people connect, communicate and organise on their own terms.
